items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father was Benny Golson. He spelled his name B-e-n-n-i-e.

ctx.x: If you could tell us the names of your parents and if you know where they were from.
My mother was Celadia – C-e- l-a-d-i-a – York. She was from Mobile, Alabama. My father was Benny Golson. He spelled his name B-e-n-n-i-e. However, I changed mine to a “y,” legally.
